entry.name: gen_dsp_history
entry.description: The history operator allows feedback in the gen patcher through the insertion of a single-sample delay. The first argument is an optional name for the history operator, which allows it to also be set externally (in the same way as the param operator). The second argument specifies an initial value of stored history (defaults to zero).
